ChartsData guide

Catalog

57 chart types. Each is one tag, <fft-widget src="<type>.json">, with its data built in and a spec to copy.


    anomalies

    An anomaly tracker: one thin lane per metric over time, the band it was expected to stay in as a faint fill, the expected value as a hairline, the actual as a line, and every day it stepped outside the band as a flagged dot.

    needs x: date, metric: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    area

    A line with a soft filled area down to zero, for a trend where the amount itself matters.

    needs x: date, y: number+

    Data and switches

    bar

    Vertical bars comparing amounts across categories.

    needs x: category, y: number+

    Data and switches

    beeswarm

    A distribution: one dot per row along a value axis, nudged apart so none overlap, optionally one row per group.

    needs value: number

    Data and switches

    board

    A status board: one column per stage with its count in the header, and the items in it as quiet cards, so where everything stands reads at a glance.

    needs label: category, stage: category

    Data and switches

    boxplot

    A box plot per group on one shared axis: a box over the middle half of the values (first to third quartile), a line at the median, whiskers to the furthest values within 1.5 box-widths, and dots for outliers beyond.

    needs value: number

    Data and switches

    bullet

    Actual against target, one compact row per item: a value bar and a target tick over three qualitative bands (poor, fair, good).

    needs label: category, value: number, target: number

    Data and switches

    bump

    Rank over time: in every period the series are ranked by value (highest first), and each series is one smooth line through its ranks, named at both ends.

    needs x: date, series: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    calendar

    A calendar heatmap: one cell per day, weeks as columns from Monday, shaded on one blue scale.

    needs date: date, value: number

    Data and switches

    candlestick

    Prices per period as candles: a thin wick from low to high around a body from open to close, in the up color when the period closed higher and the down color when lower.

    needs x: date, open: number, high: number, low: number, close: number

    Data and switches

    chord

    Flows between groups around a circle: each group an arc as long as everything it sends and receives, each flow a ribbon from its sender to its receiver, in the sender's color.

    needs source: category, target: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    choropleth

    A map with each region shaded by its value, from the weakest tint to the strongest, with a scale under it: revenue by country, share by state.

    needs id: category

    Data and switches

    donut

    Part-to-whole at a glance: a ring of up to 6 slices with the total in the middle and a legend of values and shares.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    dot

    A dot plot: one row per item and one dot per measure on one shared axis, with a hairline across each row.

    needs label: category, value: number+

    Data and switches

    dual

    Two measures with different units, such as revenue and churn, one above the other on two panels that share one time axis, each on its own scale.

    needs x: date, y: number, y2: number

    Data and switches

    dumbbell

    Before and after per item on one shared axis: a muted dot for before, an accent dot for after, joined by a line (a range plot).

    needs label: category, from: number, to: number

    Data and switches

    funnel

    Stages in order as centered bars narrowing from the first, with the conversion rate from each stage to the next and each stage's share of the first.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    gauge

    One headline number on a half-circle scale: an arc filled from min to the value, a tick at the target, the number large inside the arc and the scale's ends below; with a target, a line under the arc says where it stands (Target met, or how far to go).

    needs value: number

    Data and switches

    hbar

    Horizontal bars for rankings and long labels: label on the left, bar, value at the end.

    needs label: category, value: number+

    Data and switches

    heatmap

    A grid of cells shaded on one blue scale from light (low) to dark (high), for patterns across two categories such as weekday by hour.

    needs x: category, y: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    histogram

    A distribution as touching bars: the value's range is cut into bins on round edges, and each bar counts the rows in its bin.

    needs value: number

    Data and switches

    history

    A client's story as a vertical timeline: one event per row with its date, title, an optional second line and an amount, newest first, a dot per event colored by kind with a key, and the month written wherever it changes.

    needs date: date, title: category

    Data and switches

    horizon

    Many time series at once, each in a thin row: values are measured from a baseline and folded into bands of deepening color, blue above and red below, so a dozen series fit where one line chart would.

    needs x: date, y: number+

    Data and switches

    icicle

    A hierarchy laid flat: a column for the total, then one per level left to right, each child splitting its parent's height by value, in lighter tints of its family's color.

    needs levels: category+, value: number

    Data and switches

    kpi

    One headline number with its change against a comparison.

    needs value: number

    Data and switches

    kpis

    A row of stat tiles in one widget, each with a label, value and change: the calm way to show a handful of headline numbers.

    needs any rows

    Data and switches

    lifecycle

    Stage swimlanes: one row per item on a shared date axis, each stage drawn from its date to the next in a deepening tint of one hue, a tick at every stage date, and the last reached stage running on faintly while its next date is unknown.

    needs label: category, stages: date+

    Data and switches

    likert

    Survey answers as diverging stacked bars: one bar per question, its responses in order from one pole to the other, centered on the neutral middle so disagreement grows left and agreement right.

    needs label: category, value: number+

    Data and switches

    line

    Lines showing change over an ordered axis, usually time.

    needs x: date, y: number+

    Data and switches

    list

    A stacked list: one line per row with a label, optional detail underneath, and an optional value on the right.

    needs label: category

    Data and switches

    locator

    A small, clean map that says where things are: a marker and an always-on name for each place, such as offices, stores or sites, with a second line of detail if there is one.

    needs label: category

    Data and switches

    marimekko

    A mosaic: one column per category, as wide as its total, split into segments by each series' share of that column.

    needs x: category, series: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    matrix

    A mark matrix (a punchcard): one mark per pair of x and y, sized by a value, shaded by another, or a square where a flag is yes.

    needs x: category, y: category

    Data and switches

    meter

    Progress against a target, one meter per row: attainment as a percentage, a bar that fills to the target, and where it stands in plain words: a check and Target met, or how far it has to go (€22K to go).

    needs value: number, target: number

    Data and switches

    pareto

    The 80/20 view: categories sorted largest first as bars of their share of the total, a line through the running total, and a dashed line at the threshold.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    pie

    Part-to-whole as a full disc: up to 6 slices from twelve o'clock clockwise, each wide in proportion to its share, with the shares written on the slices and a legend of values.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    pyramid

    A population pyramid: one row per band (an age group, a tenure band), with two counts as bars growing out from a center axis on one shared scale, the left count leftward and the right count rightward.

    needs label: category, left: number, right: number

    Data and switches

    radar

    Profiles across several attributes: one spoke per row, rings for one shared scale from zero, and a soft shape per series.

    needs label: category, y: number+

    Data and switches

    ragboard

    A RAG scorecard: one row per entity (a client, a relationship manager, a deal) and one Red, Amber or Green cell per dimension, worst first, with an overall column holding each row's worst status.

    needs label: category, dimensions: category+

    Data and switches

    ragtrend

    RAG status over time: one row per entity and one small mark per period, shaped and colored by its status (a filled circle On track, a triangle At risk, a square Off track).

    needs label: category, period: date, status: category

    Data and switches

    ridgeline

    One smooth distribution curve per group on a shared axis, overlapping like a mountain range: how values spread in each group, for example deal sizes by region.

    needs value: number, group: category

    Data and switches

    rings

    Concentric progress rings, one per row from the outside in, each filled to its share of target; past the target a second lap shows how far over.

    needs label: category, value: number, target: number

    Data and switches

    rose

    A polar area chart (a Nightingale rose) for a cycle that wraps round, such as hours of the day or months of the year: one equal wedge per row, clockwise from twelve o'clock, its area true to its value.

    needs label: category, y: number+

    Data and switches

    sankey

    Flows between stages as ribbons as thick as their volume, for example traffic source to landing page to outcome.

    needs source: category, target: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    scatter

    One dot per row placed by two numbers, to show how they relate.

    needs x: number, y: number

    Data and switches

    slope

    Each item's move between two points in time, as a line from a left column to a right one on one shared scale.

    needs label: category, from: number, to: number

    Data and switches

    strips

    Unit strips: one row per item with a strip of small squares, one per unit, colored part by part in order (mandatory, recommended, optional), the total and the first part's share at the end.

    needs label: category, value: number+

    Data and switches

    sunburst

    A hierarchy as rings: the inner ring splits the total by the first level, each outer ring splits its parent's slice by the next level, in lighter tints of the parent's color.

    needs levels: category+, value: number

    Data and switches

    symbols

    A map with a circle on each place, its area true to a value: customers by state, volume by port.

    needs size: number

    Data and switches

    table

    Rows and columns.

    needs any rows

    Data and switches

    timeline

    A Gantt-style timeline: one row per task with a bar from its start to its end date, a diamond for milestones (no end), month ticks along the top and an optional today line.

    needs label: category, start: date

    Data and switches

    treemap

    Part-to-whole for many categories: tiles sized by value, kept close to square.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    variance

    Variance against plan, as in financial reporting: per row a bar from a zero line to actual minus plan, right when over and left when under, colored good or bad and labelled with its sign.

    needs label: category, value: number, target: number

    Data and switches

    waffle

    Part to whole as a 10 by 10 grid where each square is one percent, filled category by category in reading order, with a legend of values and shares.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    waterfall

    A bridge: how a total moves to another through increases and decreases, each floating from the running total, with totals standing on zero.

    needs label: category, value: number

    Data and switches

    whitespace

    The cross-sell map (whitespace analysis): one cell per client and product, filled where the client holds the product, outlined where it is an opportunity (tinted by how likely), blank where the client is not eligible.

    needs row: category, column: category, state: category

    Data and switches

    xray

    A client x-ray: one client on one card, from its first row.

    needs label: category

    Data and switches
